abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们证明了通过获得公众社会满意度来识别社会状况和不稳定因素的迫切需要。然而，受制于受试者招募和数据处理的大量人工成本，传统的自我报告方法无法实时实施或应用于大规模调查。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种根据用户的社交媒体记录来预测用户的社会满意度，特别是与经济相关的满意度的方法。我们根据人口分布，从广东省各市招募了2018名粤语活跃参与者。参与者的行为和语言特征都是从在线数据中提取的...
abstract_en: We demonstrate the critical need to identify social situation and instability factors by acquiring public social satisfaction in this research. However, subject to the large amount of manual work cost in subject recruitment and data processing, conventional self-reported method cannot be implemented in real time or applied in large scale investigation. To solve the problem, this paper proposed an approach to predict users' social satisfaction, especially for the economy-related satisfaction based on users' social media records. We recruited 2,018 Cantonese active participants from each city in Guangdong province according to the population distribution. Both behavioral and linguistic features of the participants are extracted from the online records of social media, i.e., Sina Weibo. Regression models are used to predict Sina Weibo users' social satisfaction. Furthermore, we consult the economic indexes of Guangdong in 2012, and calculate the correlations between these indexes and the predicted social satisfaction. Results indicate that social satisfaction can be significantly expressed by specific social media features; local economy satisfaction has significant positive correlations with several local economy indexes, which supports that it is reliable to predict social satisfaction from social media.

abstract_zh: 随着信息技术和工业自动化的发展，工业控制系统变得越来越复杂，增加了检测运行错误的难度。错误往往会导致行业事故，进而威胁公民财产乃至国民经济。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于数据挖掘的新型安全机制。复杂网络分析、数据预测、专家分析以及自适应降级和升级技术也被应用于解决工业控制系统的安全问题。为了保护工业控制系统，我们定义了安全保护状态。通过特定操作可以将系统切换到保护状态，最终将系统恢复到保护状态。
abstract_en: With the development of information technology and industrial automation, industrial control systems have become increasingly complicated which increases the difficulty to detect running errors. Errors usually lead to industry incidences, which in turn threaten civil property and even national economy. In this paper, we propose a novel safety mechanism based on data mining. Complex network analysis, data prediction, expert analysis and self-adaptive downgrade and upgrade techniques are also applied to solve safety problems in industrial control systems. To protect industrial control system, we define a safety protection status. The system can be switched into protection status by specific operations, which finally transfer the system back to safe status. Using data mining techniques, we propose a general safety mechanism which has four operations, including global safety, initiative safety, real-time safety, and self safety.

abstract_zh: 由于其丰富性和可用性，微博已成为进行心理学研究的理想平台。在本文中，我们提出通过微博行为来预测活跃用户的性格特征。 547 名中国微博活跃用户参与了这项研究。他们的性格特征通过“五巨头量表”进行测量，并通过网络爬虫收集微博行为的数字记录。在提取 839 个微博行为特征后，我们首先利用支持向量机 (SVM) 训练分类模型，区分在大五库存的每个维度上得分高低的参与者[已纠正]。分类准确率在 84% 到 92% 之间。我们...
abstract_en: Because of its richness and availability, micro-blogging has become an ideal platform for conducting psychological research. In this paper, we proposed to predict active users' personality traits through micro-blogging behaviors. 547 Chinese active users of micro-blogging participated in this study. Their personality traits were measured by the Big Five Inventory, and digital records of micro-blogging behaviors were collected via web crawlers. After extracting 839 micro-blogging behavioral features, we first trained classification models utilizing Support Vector Machine (SVM), differentiating participants with high and low scores on each dimension of the Big Five Inventory [corrected]. The classification accuracy ranged from 84% to 92%. We also built regression models utilizing PaceRegression methods, predicting participants' scores on each dimension of the Big Five Inventory. The Pearson correlation coefficients between predicted scores and actual scores ranged from 0.48 to 0.54. Results indicated that active users' personality traits could be predicted by micro-blogging behaviors.

abstract_zh: 由于社交媒体的快速发展以及人格研究在心理学中的核心重要性，社交媒体上的人格研究成为近年来的热门话题，但大多数研究都是在标签样本不足的情况下进行的。我们的研究旨在探索使用未标记样本来提高预测准确性。通过对1792个用户进行n个用户研究，采用局部线性半监督回归算法来预测微博用户的个性特征。给定一组微博用户的公开信息（例如关注者数量）和一些标记用户，任务是预测其他未标记用户的个性。采用局部线性半监督回归算法来建立预测...
abstract_en: Personality research on social media is a hot topic recently due to the rapid development of social media as well as the central importance of personality study in psychology, but most studies are conducted on inadequate label samples. Our research aims to explore the usage of unlabeled samples to improve the prediction accuracy. By conducting n user study with 1792 users, we adopt local linear semi-supervised regression algorithm to predict the personality traits of Micro blog users. Given a set of Micro blog users' public information (e.g., Number of followers) and a few labeled users, the task is to predict personality of other unlabeled users. The local linear semi-supervised regression algorithm has been employed to establish prediction model in this paper, and the experimental results demonstrate the usage of unlabeled data can improve the accuracy of prediction.

abstract_zh: 主观幸福感（SWB）是指人们如何体验自己的生活质量，因此及时有效地了解人们的主观幸福感水平非常重要。自我报告和访谈是评估主观幸福感的常用方法，但无法及时完成。这项研究旨在通过智能手机的使用行为来预测一个人的主观幸福感水平。我们收集了用户的智能手机使用情况和自我报告的主观幸福感，发现一些使用行为与主观幸福感相关，尤其是女性。例如，SWB 分数较高的智能手机用户倾向于使用更多的交流应用程序、玩更多的游戏和阅读更多的内容，但拍摄更少的照片。基于这些发现，我们训练了一个基于智能手机使用行为的用户主观幸福感预测模型……
abstract_en: Subjective Well-Being (SWB) refers to how people experience the quality of their lives, thus to acquire people’s SWB levels timely and effectively is very important. Self-report and interviewing are mostly used techniques for assessing SWB, but cannot be done in time. This study aims to predict one’s SWB levels by smartphone usage behaviours. We collect users’ smartphone usage and self-reported subjective well-being, and found that several usage behaviours correlate with SWB, especially for females. For example, smartphone users with higher SWB scores tend to use more communicating apps, play more games and read more, but take fewer photos. Based on these findings, we trained a predicting model of user’s SWB based on smartphone usage behaviours, and the accuracy is up to 62%. The result indicates that SWB can be identified based on smartphone usage fairly well.

abstract_en: Much research has been conducted to investigate personality and daily behavior of these only children ('Onlies') due to the Chinese one-child-per-family policy, and report the singleton generation to be more selfish. As Microblog becomes increasingly popular recently in China, we studied cyber behavior of Onlies and children with siblings ('Others') on Sina Microblog ('Weibo'), a leading Microblog service provider in China. Participants were 1792 Weibo users. Their recorded data on Weibo were downloaded to assess their cyber behaviors. The general results show that (1) Onlies have a smaller social circle; (2)Onlies are more significantly active on social platform.

title_zh: 用心理词典检测中文微博中的自杀意念

abstract_zh: 自杀是中国的主要原因之一。然而，预防自杀的技术方法具有挑战性，并且仍在开发中。最近，在几起实际的自杀案件发生之前，用户在新浪微博（类似于推特的中国社交媒体网络）上发布了有自杀意念的微博。因此，需要从微博中实时检测自杀意念，并立即提醒适当的支持小组，这可能会导致成功的预防。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用机器学习和已知的心理学技术在微博上部署的实时自杀意念检测系统。目前，我们已经确定了 53 名已知的自杀案件，他们在...上发布了自杀遗书。
abstract_en: Suicide is among the leading causes of death in China. However, technical approaches toward preventing suicide are challenging and remaining under development. Recently, several actual suicidal cases were preceded by users who posted micro blogs with suicidal ideation to Sina Weibo, a Chinese social media network akin to Twitter. It would therefore be desirable to detect suicidal ideations from micro blogs in real-time, and immediately alert appropriate support groups, which may lead to successful prevention. In this paper, we propose a real-time suicidal ideation detection system deployed over Weibo, using machine learning and known psychological techniques. Currently, we have identified 53 known suicidal cases who posted suicide notes on Weibo prior to their deaths. We explore linguistic features of these known cases using a psychological lexicon dictionary, and train an effective suicidal Weibo post detection model. 6714 tagged posts and several classifiers are used to verify the model. By combining both machine learning and psychological knowledge, SVM classifier has the best performance of different classifiers, yielding an F-measure of 68:3%, a Precision of 78:9%, and a Recall of 60:3%.

abstract_zh: 背景：自杀问题在中国备受关注。社交媒体提供了一种积极的方法来了解自杀者的行为和语言使用。目的：本研究调查中国自杀微博用户在社交媒体上的行为和言论与其他人有何不同。方法：在 33 名自杀过的中国微博用户的目标组和由 30 名无自杀意念的活跃用户组成的对照组之间进行行为和语言特征的假设检验。结果：自杀组在公开发表帖子和自我参照的程度以及使用负面词/社会过程词/认知过程这7个词类别的强度上显着超过对照组。
abstract_en: Background: Suicide issue is of great concern in China. Social media provides an active approach to understanding suicide individuals in terms of their behavior and language use. Aims: This study investigates how suicide Microblog users in China act and speak differently on social media from others. Methods: Hypothesis testing in behavioral and linguistic features was performed between a target group of 33 Chinese Microblog users who have committed suicide and a control group of 30 active users without suicidal ideation. Results: Suicide group significantly outnumbered control group in the extent of openly published posts and self-reference, and the intensity of using 7 word categories: negative words/social process words/cognitive process words/emotion process words/negative emotion words/exclusive words/physiological process words. Limitations: Information collection and confirmation of suicide users remain difficult. Conclusions: It is revealed that suicide people vary from others in certain behavioral and linguistic features in social media. This study fills the niche of suicide studies by noting specified indicators of suicide ideation for Chinese individuals online, providing insights of constructing an online alarm system for early detection and intervention of suicidal individuals.

title_zh: 预测微博用户的大五人格特征
title_en: Predicting Big Five Personality Traits of Microblog Users
authors: Bibo Hao；Rui Gao；Sha Yuan；Shuotian Bai；Ang Li；Tingshao Zhu
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 个性可以定义为使一个人独一无二的一组特征。人格研究在心理学中具有核心重要性。传统的性格评估是通过自我报告盘点的方式进行，需要大量的人工，而且无法实时完成。为了解决这些问题，本研究旨在从新浪微博的使用情况来客观地衡量大五人格。通过对 444 个用户进行用户研究，本文提出了多任务回归和增量回归算法来根据在线行为预测大五人格。结果表明，通过在线微博的使用可以高精度地预测性格。
abstract_en: Personality can be defined as a set of characteristics which makes a person unique. The study of personality is of central importance in psychology. Conventional personality assessment is performed by self-report inventory, which costs much manual efforts and cannot be done in real time. To solve these problems, this research aims to measure the Big-Five personality from the usages of Sina Microblog objectively. By conducting a user study with 444 users, this paper proposes multi-task regression and incremental regression algorithms to predict the Big-Five personality from online behaviors. The results indicate that personality can be predicted with a high accuracy through online Microblog usage.

title_zh: 中国退休人员互联网使用与公正世界普遍信念之间的关系
title_en: Relationship Between Internet Use and General Belief in a Just World Among Chinese Retirees
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 作为获取信息的新兴媒介，互联网可能会影响用户（包括老年人）看待或思考周围世界的方式。本研究利用对中国 50 岁及以上退休人员 (N=12,309) 的调查数据，探讨了使用互联网获取世界信息与对公正世界的普遍信念 (GBJW) 之间的关系。结果表明，主要用于获取新闻信息的互联网使用与 GBJW 呈负相关。具体而言，互联网用户的 GBJW 水平低于非互联网用户；退休人员访问网站获取新闻信息的时间越多，他们就越不可能相信世界是公正的。此外，与拥有...的退休人员相比
abstract_en: As an emerging medium for acquiring information, the Internet might affect how users, including older adults, view or think about the world around them. Using data from a survey of retirees aged 50 years and above (N=12,309) in China, the present study examined the relationship between Internet use for acquiring information about the world and general belief in a just world (GBJW). The results indicated that Internet use primarily for obtaining news information was negatively related to GBJW. Specifically, Internet users had lower levels of GBJW than nonusers; the more time retirees spent visiting Web sites to acquire news information, the less likely they were to believe that the world is just. In addition, compared with retirees who had acquired information about the world through other means (including books, newspapers or magazines, radio and television, and direct communication with other people), those who had acquired information primarily using the Internet showed lower levels of GBJW. The significance and limitations of the current study are discussed.

title_zh: 自我报告与网络日志：哪一种更能预测网站用户的个性？
title_en: Self-Report Versus Web-Log: Which One is Better to Predict Personality of Website Users?
venue: Int. J. Cyber Behav. Psychol. Learn.
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 许多研究调查了性格与社交网站（SNS）上网络使用行为之间的关系，而网络使用行为的测量依赖于自我报告技术。在这项研究中，作者调查了网络使用行为的自我报告和网络日志测量之间的相关性，并进一步研究了哪一种可以更好地预测用户的个性。有两个主要发现：(a) 网络使用行为的自我报告和网络日志测量之间存在多种关系； (b) 网络日志数据比自我报告数据更能预测用户的性格。它表明应该区别对待这两组数据（自我报告和网络日志），并且它适合预测用户的个性...
abstract_en: Number of studies have investigated the relationship between personality and web use behaviors on Social Network Sites (SNS), and the measurement of web use behaviors relies on self-report technique. In this study, the authors investigated the correlation between self-report and web-log measures of web use behaviors, and further examined which one would be better to predict user’s personality. There are two major findings: (a) a diverse relationship exists between self-report and web-log measures of web use behaviors; (b) web-log data is a better predictor of user’s personality than self-report data. It suggests that such two sets of data (self-report and web-log) should be treated differently, and it is suitable to predict user’s personality using web-log data.

title_zh: MobileSens：基于移动设备的无处不在的心理实验室

venue: Int. J. Cyber Behav. Psychol. Learn.

abstract_zh: 在心理学研究中，在现实生活的非实验场景下很难获得非侵入性的、实时的、客观的数据。本文提出了一种系统（MobileSens），用于自动记录 Android 移动设备上的用户行为（例如，打开设备、发送消息和上网），并通过通用分组无线服务（GPRS）将数据上传到网络服务器以进行后续分析。在测试过程中，MobileSens 在智能手机和平板电脑上都能平稳高效地运行。这表明，在未来，这种数据获取方法可以提高进行心理学研究的绩效。
abstract_en: In psychological research, it is difficult to acquire unintrusive, real-time and objective data under real-life non-experimental scenario. This article proposes a system (MobileSens) for automatically recording user behavior on Android mobile device (e.g., turning on device, sending messages, and web surfing), and uploading data to web server through General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) for subsequent analysis. During testing, MobileSens runs smoothly and efficiently on both the smartphone and tablet computer. It indicates that, in the future, this method of data acquisition can improve the performance of conducting psychological research.

title_zh: 基于社交网站用户行为的大五人格预测
title_en: Big-Five Personality Prediction Based on User Behaviors at Social Network Sites
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 社交网站 (SNS) 上已经提供了许多客户服务，包括用户推荐和媒体互动等。人们强烈希望为在线用户提供更适合个人需求的更专注和个性化的服务，这通常很大程度上取决于用户的内在个性。然而，在进行适当的心理分析方面却做得很少，这对于从用户的内在个性解释其外在行为至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，旨在通过直接从用户的 SNS 行为预测所谓的“五大人格”来促进这一研究方向。与传统的基于库存的心理分析相比，我们通过...
abstract_en: Many customer services are already available at Social Network Sites (SNSs), including user recommendation and media interaction, to name a few. There are strong desires to provide online users more dedicated and personalized services that fit into individual's need, usually strongly depending on the inner personalities of the user. However, little has been done to conduct proper psychological analysis, crucial for explaining the user's outer behaviors from their inner personality. In this paper, we propose an approach that intends to facilitate this line of research by directly predicting the so called Big-Five Personality from user's SNS behaviors. Comparing to the conventional inventory-based psychological analysis, we demonstrate via experimental studies that users' personalities can be predicted with reasonable precision based on their online behaviors. Except for proving some former behavior-personality correlation results, our experiments show that extraversion is positively related to one's status republishing proportion and neuroticism is positively related to the proportion of one's angry blogs (blogs making people angry).

title_zh: 预测网络浏览背景下的心理健康状况
title_en: Predicting Mental Health Status in the Context of Web Browsing
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 当前，世界各地的人们都遭受着精神障碍的困扰。鉴于互联网的广泛使用，我们建议根据浏览行为来预测用户的心理健康状况，并进一步提出调整建议。为了识别心理健康状况，我们提取用户的网页浏览行为，并训练支持向量机（SVM）模型进行预测。根据预测的状态，我们的推荐系统会生成调整精神障碍的建议。我们实现了一个名为Web Mind的系统作为集成预测模型和推荐引擎的实验平台。我们进行了用户研究来测试预测模型的有效性，结果表明...
abstract_en: Currently, people around the world are suffering from mental disorders. Given the wide-spread use of the Internet, we propose to predict users' mental health status based on browsing behavior, and further recommend suggestions for adjustment. To identify mental health status, we extract the user's web browsing behavior, and train a Support Vector Machine(SVM) model for prediction. Based on the predicted status, our recommender system generates suggestions for adjusting mental disorders. We have implemented a system named Web Mind as the experimental platform integrated with the predicting model and recommendation engine. We have conducted user study to test the effectiveness of the predicting model, and the result demonstrates that the recommender system performs fairly well.

abstract_zh: 随着社会的发展和进步，人类在工作、学习、生活中都承受着压力。为了解决这个问题，人们对认知行为疗法进行了许多研究。在本文中，我们介绍了我们的心理健康自助系统，该系统将机器学习应用于认知行为治疗。根据随机对照用户研究，我们的系统被证明可以有效减少用户的抑郁症。

Many researches have been done on cognitive-behavior therapy to solve this problem. According to the randomized controlled user study, our system is proven effective to reduce users' depressive disorders.

title_zh: 使用决策树根据网络行为预测心理健康状况
title_en: Using decision tree to predict mental health status based on web behavior
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
topics: 情感智能；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 了解网络用户的心理特征非常重要，这可以帮助人们更好地适应这个快速而复杂的网络世界。如今，网络行为对人们的生活和心理健康发挥着重要作用。临床心理学普遍认为，心理活动和状态是通过偏好、选择等行为方式来表达的。网络行为作为行为的一部分，理应具有检测用户心理状态的意义。换句话说，个人的心理状态或情绪都体现在这些互联网使用行为的细节中。在本文中，我们建议建立一个决策树模型来找出网络用户的心理健康与其网络行为之间的关系。我们集团开展...
abstract_en: It is very important to understand web users' psychological characteristics, which can help people adapt this rapid and complicated internet world better. Nowadays, web behavior plays a significant role in people's life and mental health. It is widely accepted in clinical psychology that mental activities and status are expressed in a way of behavior such as preference and choice. Web behavior, as a part of behavior, is supposed to be a meaning to detect users' mental status. In other words, individuals' mental status or moods are showed in these details of Internet usage behavior. In this paper, we propose to build a decision tree model to find out the relationship of web users' mental health and their behavior on the web. Our group conducts a questionnaire test to enroll subjects that use Internet frequently, and then extracts typical behavior features that could be mapped to virtual society and used to predict the users' mental health. Accordingly, subjects are also required to finish the Psychological Health Inventory (PHI) questionnaire as the criterion variables we are going to predict. Finally we get a collection of behavior features of importance to predict 7 mental disorders and the precision and recall are fairly good.

abstract_zh: 传统上，心理调查使用问卷来收集实验数据。随着互联网的普及，网络行为记录可能为数据采集提供新的选择。在本文中，我们研究了网络行为和心理特征，并总结了该方向的全球成就。我们发现网络行为与用户的个性和其他心理特征之间存在密切关系。
abstract_en: Traditionally, questionnaire is used in psychological investigation to collect experiment data. With the prevalence of Internet, web behavior record may provide a new choice for data collection. In this paper, we investigate both web behavior and psychological characteristic, and summarize the worldwide achievement on this direction. We find strong relations between web behavior and the users' personalities and other psychological traits.

title_zh: 网络行为和心理健康调查
title_en: A survey of web behavior and mental health
venue: International Conference on Pervasive Computing and Applications (ICPCA)
authors: Fan Zhang；Tingshao Zhu；Ang Li；Yilin Li；Xinguo Xu
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
abstract_zh: 传统的心理状态检测方法主要依靠受试者填写的问卷。答案的准确性受到受试者的知识、记忆能力、答案的真实性等多种因素的影响。为了提高准确性，我们建议利用网络行为来代替问卷来识别心理状态。当前，网络在大多数人的生活中扮演着重要的角色，我们可以更加轻松、准确地获取网络用户的访问历史。这样我们就可以根据客观观察来进行识别。在本文中，我们调查了与心理健康相关的各种网络行为，并讨论了使用网络行为来诊断相关心理健康和...的可能性。
abstract_en: The traditional approach to detect mental state mainly depends on questionnaires completed by the subjects. The accuracy of answer is affected by many factors including subject's knowledge, the ability of memory, and the authenticity of answer. In order to improve the accuracy, we propose to utilize web behaviors to identify mental state instead of questionnaires. Currently, the web plays a key role in most people's lives, and we may acquire web user's access history more easily and accurately. Thus we are able to make the identification based on the objective observations. In this paper, we investigate various web behaviors which relate to mental health, and discuss the possibility to use web behaviors to diagnose related mental health under different circumstances.

title_zh: 在线情绪标签是否真实反映了我们的经历？
title_en: Are online mood labels a true reflection of our experiences?
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 众所周知，网络新闻会引发读者不同的情绪。人们对网络新闻的读者情绪分类进行了许多研究，这些研究利用读者标记的新闻。然而，网络上的情绪标签是否与很少在网络上标签新闻的读者一致尚不得而知。在本文中，我们描述了一项用户研究，该研究旨在收集带有在线情绪标签的新闻，并从从未在网络上这样做过的参与者那里获取投票。结果表明，在线新闻引发的情绪与线下参与者投票的情绪是一致的，这表明这些在线情绪标签在某种程度上是我们经历的真实反映。
abstract_en: It is well known that the online news can trigger different moods in readers. Many researches have been done on reader mood classification of online news, which use the news that have been labeled by readers. However, it is still unknown whether the mood labels on line are consistent with the readers who seldom label any news on the web. In this paper, we describe a user study which is designed to collect news with online mood labels and acquire the votes from the participators that never did so on the web. The result shows that moods evoked by online news are consistent with the mood voted by those offline participators, which demonstrates that to some degree these online mood labels are a true reflection of our experiences.

abstract_zh: 为了提供更好的服务，了解用户在移动设备上的行为非常重要。在本文中，我们提出了一个日志记录框架MobileSens，用于记录用户在Andriod移动设备（包括智能手机和pad）上的操作。操作包括打开屏幕、发送消息、浏览网页等。该系统通过GPRS（通用分组无线服务）将数据上传到服务器进行进一步分析。 MobileSens 监视系统事件，并识别与用户行为相关的任何事件。记录使用信息可以帮助我们了解用户的意图和心理状态，从而完善用户界面，使这些移动设备更好地为人们服务。
abstract_en: To provide a better service, it is important to understand user's behavior on mobile device. In this paper, we propose a framework for logging, MobileSens, to record users' operations on Andriod mobile device, including smart phone and pad. The operations include turning on screen, sending messages, and browsing the web, etc. This system uploads the data to server via GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) for further analysis. MobileSens monitors system events, and identifies any event that related to the user behavior. Recording the usage information could help us understand the user's intention and mental status, thus refine the user interface, then make these mobile devices serve people better.

title_zh: 从视频中提取复杂背景的字幕
title_en: Extracting Captions in Complex Background from Videos
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 视频中的字幕对于自动理解和索引视频内容起着重要作用，因为许多语义信息与其相关。本文提出了一种从视频中提取字幕的有效方法，其中利用多种不同类别的特征（边缘、颜色、笔划等），并考虑字幕的时空特征。首先，我们的方法利用梯度方向的分布将视频在时间上分解为一系列剪辑，使得每个剪辑最多包含一个字幕，这使得连续提取计算更加高效和准确。对于每个剪辑，然后利用边缘和角信息来定位文本区域。另外，文字...
abstract_en: Captions in videos play a significant role for automatically understanding and indexing video content, since much semantic information is associated with them. This paper presents an effective approach to extracting captions from videos, in which multiple different categories of features (edge, color, stroke etc.) are utilized, and the spatio-temporal characteristics of captions are considered. First, our method exploits the distribution of gradient directions to decompose a video into a sequence of clips temporally, so that each clip contains a caption at most, which makes the successive extraction computation more efficient and accurate. For each clip, the edge and corner information are then utilized to locate text regions. Further, text pixels are extracted based on the assumption that text pixels in text regions always have homogeneous color, and their quantity dominates the region relative to non-text pixels with different colors. Finally, the segmentation results are further refined. The encouraging experimental results on 2565 characters have preliminarily validated our approach.

title_zh: 调节情绪自我效能、大五人格与网络事件态度的关系
title_en: The relationship between regulatory emotional self-efficacy, Big-Five personality and Internet events attitude
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 互联网正迅速成为社会生活中最重要的部分之一。这样人们就可以更加关注网络事件。然而，尚不清楚哪些心理因素影响互联网事件态度。本研究旨在探讨大五人格和调节情绪自我效能影响网络事件态度的机制。在本研究中，183名参与者完成了一系列在线发布的问卷，问卷包括大五人格量表、RESE量表、网络事件态度量表。结果表明，RESE 和大五人格对互联网事件的态度有显着影响，此外，RESE 与……呈正相关。
abstract_en: Internet is quickly becoming one of the most important parts in social life. As such people could pay more attention to the Internet events. However, it is not clear that which psychological factors influence Internet event attitudes. The present research was to investigate the mechanism of how Big-Five personality and regulatory emotional self-efficacy influence the attitude on Internet event. In the present study, 183 participants completed a series questionnaires posted online, and the questionnaire includes Big-Five Personality Scales, RESE Scales, Internet Event Attitude Scales. We run two experiments, one uses sentiment words extracted from HowNet and a Chinese thesaurus: TongYiCi CiLin, and the other is not. We develop a novel keyword extraction method named NATF-PDF, which is based on TFPDF algorithm, combined with supervised learning theory for keyword extraction. The paper concludes with an overview of our WebIC which integrates the model into a web browser, to help the user find the relevant information effectively from the web.

abstract_zh: 协同过滤是最广泛使用的技术，它可以根据其他用户的意见为活跃用户生成推荐。然而，挑战在于有时数据集太稀疏而无法识别用户兴趣的相似性。二分图上的随机游走被提出来解决这个问题。通过一阶马尔可夫过程探索传递关联，它能够为活跃用户找到一组志同道合的用户，即使他们没有共同评分的项目。它适用于二进制评级，但人们通常用数字尺度（例如 1-5）对项目进行评级，这使得它很难应用。在本文中，我们提出了二阶马尔可夫过程来克服该限制。实验结果...
abstract_en: Collaborative filtering is the most widely used technique to generate recommendations for an active user by the opinions of the others. However, the challenge is that sometimes the data set is too sparse to identify the similarities of user interests. Random walk on bipartite graphs has been proposed to solve this problem. By exploring transitive association through the first-order Markov process, it is able to find a group of like-minded users for an active user, even if they have no co-rated items. It works for the ratings in binary, but quite often people rate items with numerical scale (e.g. 1-5), which makes it hard to be applied. In this paper, we propose a second-order Markov process to overcome the limitation. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach outperforms the classic collaborative filtering methods with substantial improvements in prediction accuracy and coverage on sparse data set.

abstract_zh: 意向是一种心理状态，是人类行为的驱动力，它与信念、欲望、目标等其他心理现象相关。理解意图的特征及其作用机制已引起哲学、心理学、计算机科学等多个学科的关注。尽管这种关系得到了形式上的证明，但由于心理活动的复杂性，始终存在引入弱相关性的风险。许多Web应用程序，例如受众定位、协同过滤和入侵检测等，都采用意图概念来解释这些系统的结果。但他们缺乏调整其性能的基本理论框架。在这...
abstract_en: Intention is a mental state and a driving force of human behaviors, which associates with other psychological phenomena, such as belief, desire, and goal. Understanding intention's characteristics and working mechanism has caught the attentions from several disciplines, such as philosophy, psychology, computer science. Although the relationship was proven formally, there always exist some risks of introducing weak correlation because of the complexity of psychological activity. A lot of Web applications, such as audience targeting, collaborative filtering, and intrusion detecting etc., take intention concept for interpreting those system's results. But they are lack of a fundamental theoretical framework for tuning their performance. In this paper, we survey some key concepts developed in three disciplines and sum up five assumptions affecting the intention computing. We also propose a framework for modelling intention prediction and describe our I-I-I criteria model which is able to help us verify an intention computing model, and finally, we conclude by highlighting the salient features of this paper.

abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种寻找满足用户当前信息需求的网页的新方法。该方法根据用户访问过的页面内容以及用户对这些页面应用的操作来推断用户的需求。与试图了解用户长期兴趣的基于内容的系统不同，我们的系统学习独立于用户的行为模式，根据用户当前的浏览会话来识别用户当前的信息需求，然后使用此信息来建议旨在满足此需求的特定页面。我们的系统从为期五周的用户研究中收集的标记数据中学习这些行为模式，该研究涉及一百多名参与者的日常任务。我们测试了这个...
abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel method to find Web pages that satisfy the user’s current information need. The method infers the user’s need from the content of the pages the user has visited and the actions the user has applied to these pages. Unlike content-based systems that attempt to learn a user’s long-term interests, our system learns user-independent patterns of behavior that identify the user’s current information need, based on his/her current browsing session, then uses this information to suggest specific pages intended to address this need. Our system learns these behavior patterns from labeled data collected during a five-week user study, involving over one hundred participants working on their day-to-day tasks. We tested this learned model in a second phase of this same study, and found that this model can effectively identify the information needs of new users as they browse previously unseen pages, and that we can use this information to help them find relevant pages. 1

abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel method for assessing the performance of any Web recommendation function (i.e., user model), M, used in a Web recommender sytem, based on an off-line computation using labeled session data. Each labeled session consists of a sequence of Web pages followed by a page p (IC) that contains information the user claims is relevant. We then apply M to produce a corresponding suggested page p (S). In general, we say that M is good if p (S) has content “similar ” to the associated p (IC) , based on the the same session. This paper defines a number of functions for estimating this p (S) to p (IC) similarity that can be used to evaluate any new models off-line, and provides empirical data to demonstrate that evaluations based on these similarity functions match our intuitions. 1

title_zh: 学习浏览行为模型来推荐相关网页
title_en: Learning Browsing Behavior Models to Recommend Relevant Web Pages
authors: Tingshao Zhu；Russell Greiner；Hoffmann Gerald；Kevin Jewell；Bob Price
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了我们对学习浏览行为模型的研究，该模型用于根据用户在当前网络会话期间所采取的操作来推断用户的信息需求（对应于一组单词），然后使用此信息从网络上的任何位置查找相关页面。这些模型是在为期五周的用户研究中从一百多名用户那里学到的，是特定于会话的，但与用户和网站无关。我们的实证结果表明，即使用户浏览了以前未见过的包含不熟悉单词的页面，他们也可以识别并满足用户当前的信息需求。
abstract_en: We introduce our research on learning browsing behavior models for inferring a user’s information need (corresponding to a set of words) based on the actions he has taken during his current web session, and then using this information to find relevant pages, from essentially anywhere on the web. The models, learned from over one hundred users during a five-week user study, are session-specific but user- and website-independent. Our empirical results suggest that they can identify and satisfy the current information needs of users, even if they browse previously unseen pages containing unfamiliar words.

abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种新方法，用于根据用户访问过的页面内容以及用户对这些页面应用的操作来预测网络用户当前的信息需求。这一推论基于一个参数化模型，即用户选择的操作序列如何指示页面内容满足用户信息需求的程度。我们证明可以使用标记语料库中的标准方法来估计模型参数。实验室实验数据表明，预测模型可以有效识别新用户浏览以前未见过的页面的信息需求。本文最后概述了我们的“完整网络”推荐系统 WebIC，该系统使用预测...
abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel method for predicting the current information need of a web user from the content of the pages the user has visited and the actions the user has applied to these pages. This inference is based on a parameterized model of how the sequence of actions chosen by the user indicates the degree to which page content satisfies the user’s information need. We show that the model parameters can be estimated using standard methods from a labelled corpus. Data from lab experiments demonstrate that the prediction model can effectively identify the information needs of new users, browsing previously unseen pages. The paper concludes with an overview of our “complete-web ” recommendation system, WebIC, which uses the prediction model to recommend useful pages to the user, from anywhere on the Web. 1

abstract_zh: 有许多推荐系统可以在单个网站内推荐其他（据称相似）用户访问过的网页。相比之下，我们的目标是一个可以从网络任何地方推荐“信息内容”（IC）页面的系统，即包含与用户相关的信息的页面。本文描述了我们如何应对这一挑战，我们首先收集了一些带注释的用户会话，每个页面都包含一个位，指示它是否是 IC。然后，我们的系统 ICPF 使用该集合来了解此类 IC 页面中出现的单词的特征，即单词的“浏览特征”（例如，用户是否遵循锚点包含该单词的链接等）。本文介绍了...
abstract_en: There are a number of recommendation systems that can suggest the webpages, within a single website, that other (purportedly similar) users have visited. By contrast, our goal is a system that can recommend “information content” (IC) pages — i.e., pages that contain information relevant to the user — from anywhere in the web. This paper describes how we addressed this challenge, We first collected a number of annotated user sessions, whose pages each include a bit indicating whether it was IC. Our system, ICPF, then used this collection to learn the characteristics of words that appear in such IC-pages, in terms of the word’s “browsing features” (e.g., did the user follow links whose anchor included this word, etc.). This paper describes the ICPF system, as well as a tool (AIE) we developed to help users annotate their sessions, and a study we performed to collect these annotated sessions. We also present empirical data that validate the effectiveness of this approach.

abstract_zh: 基音模型在语音合成中非常重要，它主要描述基音的变化。为了合成具有高清晰度和自然度的语音，系统应该具有适当的音调模型。我们尝试通过数据挖掘从实际语音样本中找到音调模型。一个名为 SpeechDM 的原型系统已经实现，用于从中文的两个词短语中提取模式。 Dataset用于数据管理，多线程训练任务由训练管理器控制。本文首先给出了流程，然后详细介绍了每个步骤。最后给出了一些结果和结论。
abstract_en: Pitch model is very important in speech synthesis, and it mainly describes the variation of pitch. In order to synthesize speech with high intelligibility and naturalness, a system should be with an appropriate pitch model. We try to find the pitch model from actual speech samples by data mining. A prototype system called SpeechDM has been implemented to extract patterns from two-word phrase of Chinese. Dataset is used for data management, and multi-thread training tasks are controlled by training manager. This paper gives the process firstly, then each step is introduced in detail. Some results and conclusions are given at last.
